cs.t: Don't have one to recommend for NVMe. For SATA though... we have several Crucial MX500s 1TB that are approaching 2PB written, and none have failed. It's a shame this didn't transfer to their NVMe SSDs- they are all pretty harsh underperformers (though none broke).
cs.th: WD refused to answer our questions about its self-wiping SanDisk SSDs
